description:
A Fresh Way to Do Statistics

JASP is a cross-platform software that allows you to conduct statistical analyses in seconds, and without having to learn programming or risking a programming mistake. It aims to be a complete statistical package for both Bayesian and Frequentist statistical methods, that is easy to use and familiar to users of SPSS.
What's New
- Interactive plots using Plotly library (https://plotly.com/) in https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/pull/6314
- Possibility to add Reference lines/points in plots in https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/pull/6319
Important Fixes
- Windows EFS crash on all saves fixed
- Windows Junction removed
- JASP crashes on broken AI input
- Locale setting should be used at the right moment (issues https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/4556, https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/4520, https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/4322) in https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/pull/6330
- Leave empty values out of analyses when a column has no labels (Issue https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-issues/issues/4536) in https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/pull/6331
- Fix drop issues with Variables List (https://github.com/jasp-stats/jasp-desktop/pull/6323)
